_comment: CFTC Commitments of Traders (COT) via the CFTC Public Reporting Environment,
a Socrata site at publicreporting.cftc.gov. Weekly positions as of Tuesday,
published Friday 15:30 ET (shifted by federal holidays).
Two routes to the same rows:
soda3: POST https://publicreporting.cftc.gov/api/v3/views/{dataset}/query.json
JSON body {query, page: {pageNumber, pageSize}, includeSynthetic}.
Socrata's SODA3 docs (dev.socrata.com/docs/queries, checked
2026-09-24) say query requests must carry an app token or be
authenticated. Set CFTC_APP_TOKEN (sent as X-App-Token) to use it.
soda2: GET https://publicreporting.cftc.gov/resource/{dataset}.json?$query=...
Keyless (lower throttling limit per IP). Verified returning Gold
rows for 6dca-aqww and 72hh-3qpy on 2026-09-24.
The fetcher tries soda3 first when a token is set, otherwise soda2 first,
and falls back to the other route on 401/403 or a network failure.
Filter on cftc_contract_market_code, not cftc_commodity_code: the commodity
code is padded inconsistently ('088' on 2022 rows, '088 ' with a trailing
space on 2026 rows), so WHERE cftc_commodity_code = '088' silently returns
only the older weeks. contract_market_name
'GOLD' is exact today, but one commodity can list on several exchanges,
and the six-character market code (088691 = COMEX gold) names one contract.

tff_fut.title: Traders in Financial Futures - Futures Only

tff_combined.title: Traders in Financial Futures - Futures and Options Combined

_reports_note: An empty 'verified' means the dataset id is the one CFTC documents but no
live row has been checked from this pipeline yet. The parser keeps every
field in extra_json, so a surprise field name loses nothing.
